newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: Zambia's three-month T-bill discount rate down.
newsitem.headline: Zambia's three-month T-bill discount rate down.

text.p: Zambia's central bank said on Monday it had sold three-month treasury bills at an average discount rate of 25.0758 percent at its latest auction.
The bank said it sold 14 billion kwacha in 91-day bills on tenders received at last Thursday's weekly auction. The discount was slightly down on the previous week's 26.6679 percent.
It also said seven billion kwacha in 28-day treasury bills were sold at an average discount rate of 22.2773 percent, down from an earlier 22.9921 percent.
The bank sold five billion kwacha in six-month (182 days) treasury bills at an average discount rate of 24.1517 percent, down from a previous 25.0223 percent a week earlier.
